title.en: flea at eastern market, nine to four.
title.de: flohmarkt am eastern market, neun bis vier.
title.tr: eastern market'te bit pazarı, dokuzdan dörde.

line.en: the sunday flea at eastern market, seventh and c street se, 9 to 4. free to walk in. sunset is 16:54, so go in the morning.
line.de: der sonntags-flohmarkt am eastern market, 7th und c street se, 9 bis 16 uhr. der eintritt ist frei. sonnenuntergang ist um 16:54, also am vormittag hingehen.
line.tr: eastern market'in pazar günü bit pazarı, 7th ve c street se, 09:00–16:00. giriş ücretsiz. gün batımı 16:54'te, o yüzden sabah gidin.

sparks.why: Flea Market at Eastern Market, 7th & C St SE, open Sundays 9am-4pm, free (washington.org); sunset 16:54 on 15 Nov (weather2travel).
